$comment: Continuous opportunity + portfolio-intel overlay. Default OFF. Does not lower ChiefTrader quorum, does not enable QUANT or LIVE, does not call placeOrder. Scanning thousands of IEX symbols is intentionally not supported — Alpaca IEX is a bounded subscription feed.
honesty: Continuous intelligence, not continuous trading. OpportunityDiscovery never emits TRADE_IDEA_GENERATED. Watchlist may include reviewed watchUniverseSymbols (still capped). Penny names may be watched only if listed in pennyWatchSymbols; BUY still hits applyAssetIdeaGate and MARKET-unfit until a reviewed OMS LIMIT. OpportunityScreener ideas need ARGUS_OPPORTUNITY_IDEAS_ENABLED. ChiefTrader 0.75 / min-2 unchanged. ARGUS_BROAD_UNIVERSE_ENABLED additively widens the seed/watch symbol list with a liquidity/price/spread-screened Alpaca tradable-assets universe (default OFF) - it still only ever produces watch candidates through the same evaluateOpportunityCandidate gate, never a trade idea directly.
